SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D..129......
Date............3..4..29

April 2, 0

Miao Chi Ping, Esq.,
Mayor,
Yu Yao Hsien.

Dear Sir :-

In reply to your letter of March 26,
requesting the arrest of one Shao Chi Zung
(邵啟仁), I regret I am unable to apprehend
this person unless a warrant in proper order
is presented in the usual way stating the article
or articles of the Chinese Criminal Code contravened,
and that this be accompanied by witnesses and
evidence to make out a prima facie case in the
local Provisional Court.

Yours faithfully,
Original signed by
A. S. A.

Acting Director of Criminal Investigation.

敬覆者接奉三月廿六日
大函請求逮捕邵啟仁一節鄙人頗
以不能逮捕其人為歉除非
單處並普通格式提案由稱其
人觸犯中華民國現行新刑律第幾
條或其他條例須填事證人檢并証
據於該地臨時法院中証明本案似應
出處方希查照此致
的桃縣
苗啓平縣長
代理刑事科處長謹覆

日期............3..4..29

1929年4月2日，

苗啓平先生，
縣長，
餘姚縣。

敬啟者：-

覆復閣下三月二十六日来函，請求逮捕邵啟仁（邵啟仁）一事，鄙人深感抱歉，除非按慣例提交格式正規的逮捕令，指明該人違反《中華民國刑法》之具體條款，並附帶證人及證據，以便在當地臨時法院確立初步案件成立，否則本人無法逮捕此人。

此致
敬禮

pages.en:
Translation of despatch No.841 to the
Council from Mayor of Yu Yao Hsien (餘姚縣)
Chekiang. Dated 26th March 1929.
-----------------------

Shao Ch'i-Zung (邵啟仁): Requesting arrest of
--------------

Receipt is acknowledged of a letter from the Director of
Criminal Intelligence stating that the residence of Shao Ch'i-zeng
had been discovered, but as the charge against the man was not clearly
defined he could not be arrested.
Shao Ch'i-zeng alias Ta T'ou Ch'i-zeng (大頭 啟仁)
is accused of gambling; this was explained in a former letter. The
Council is again asked to despatch detectives to the back-room on the
upper floor of No.27, Te Yu Li, Nanking Road, to arrest the said
accused and to send him to Yu Yao Hsien for trial.
(Chopped) Miao Ch'i-p'ing (苗 啟 平),
Mayor.

C. Klienb.
27 MAR 1929

（批：Per
Premier's dir.
attached
J.C.D.Ry.）

浙江餘姚縣（餘姚縣）縣長於1929年3月26日發給工部局的第841號公函譯文。
-----------------------

邵啟仁（邵啟仁）：請求逮捕
--------------

茲收到刑事情報處處長來函，稱已發現邵啟增的住所，但由於對該人的指控不明確，故無法逮捕。
邵啟增，又名大頭啟仁（大頭 啟仁），被控賭博；此事在前一封來信中已作說明。再次請求工部局派遣偵探前往南京路德裕里27號樓上的後間，逮捕上述被告，並將其押送至餘姚縣受審。
（蓋章）苗啟平（苗 啟 平），
縣長。

C. Klienb.
1929年3月27日

（批：根據
總理指示
附件
J.C.D.Ry.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 128
Date 21. 3. 29

March 21, 9

Dear Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter of March 17 regarding one Shao Chi Zung
residing at 27 Teh Yu Li, Nanking Road, and in
reply to inform you that the person in question
has been located at the address mentioned, but as
no charge has been preferred against him he cannot
be arrested by this department.

Yours faithfully,

A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Chinese Copy
also

Mayor of Yu Yao Hsien,
Chekiang.

上海公共租界工部局警務處
刑事偵查處登記室
編號 I. O. D. 128
日期 1929年3月21日

1929年3月21日，

敬啟者，

茲確認收到閣下3月17日關於居住在南京路德裕里27號的邵啟仁一事的來函，並回覆告知，有關人員已在上述地址被找到，但由於未對其提出任何指控，本部門無法逮捕此人。

此致
敬禮，

代理刑事偵查處處長。

中文副本
亦送

浙江餘姚縣縣長。

March 21, 1929.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
A/D.C.I.
Sir,

With reference to the attached dispatch
received through mail from the Mayor of Yu Yao Hsien,
Chekiang, requesting the Municipal Police to arrest one
Shao Chi Zung(邵啟仁), living at No. 27 Teh Yu Li, Nanking
Road, on a charge of conducting gambling at Yu Yao Hsien,
I beg to report that this morning Shao Chi Zung was sent
to this office and interrogated. He stated that
he was wanted by the Mayor of the Yu Yao Hsien, Chekiang,
for bribing police officers on behalf of some gambling dens
there, and that he fled to Shanghai in February, 1929.
He is unemployed and now living with his wife at No. 167
Shanhaikwan Road. He frequents a small gambling den
or club at No. 27 Lloyd Road, and so far we have nothing
against him.

He is being temporarily detained at this office
pending your instructions.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Loo Shing Tih
C⁰ D.C.I.

(刑事偵查處) 辦公室備忘錄
代理刑事偵查處處長
先生，

關於隨附的通過郵件收到的浙江餘姚縣縣長發來的公函，請求公共租界警務處逮捕居住在南京路德裕里27號的邵啟仁（邵啟仁），指控其在餘姚縣開設賭場，本人謹此報告，今早邵啟仁已被送至本辦公室並接受訊問。他聲稱，浙江餘姚縣縣長通緝他，是因為他代表當地一些賭窟賄賂警察官員，他於1929年2月逃至上海。他目前失業，與妻子住在山海關路167號。他常去勞合路27號的一個小賭窟或俱樂部，迄今為止我們沒有掌握針對他的任何罪證。

他正被暫時拘留在本辦公室，等候閣下指示。

先生，
您忠順的僕人，
陸星迪 (Loo Shing Tih)
刑事偵查處協理

Translation of Despatch No.821 to the Council from
Mayor of Yü Yao Hsien (餘 姚 縣), Chekiang.
Dated 17th March, 1929.
------------------
Shao Ch'i-sung = Requesting his arrest.
It is reported by detectives that the notorious gambler
Shao Ch'i-sung (邵 啟 仁) alias Da T'ou Ché-zung (大 頭 啟 仁),
is in hiding in the back room on the upper floor of No.27, Teh Yu
Li, Nanking Road. The Council is asked to make enquiries, to
immediately despatch detectives to arrest the said gambler Shao,
and to send him to Yü Yao Hsien for trial.
(Chopped) Miao Ché-ping (苗 啟 平),
Mayor.
C. Kline.
19 MAR. 1929
